name: Fabro
description: Installs the Fabro CLI and a guided setup wizard that connects Fabro to a ChatGPT/OpenAI account using OAuth device code, which works in Codespaces, local dev containers, and over SSH.

version.description: Fabro version to install. Use 'latest' to track the newest release, or pin an exact version for reproducible containers.

provider.description: Which LLM provider the setup wizard offers first. 'openai' uses a ChatGPT/Codex subscription over OAuth device code; the others prompt for an API key.

autoStartServer.description: Start the local Fabro server automatically when the container is created.

shellBanner.description: Print a one-line 'run fabro-setup' hint in new interactive shells until setup is complete. Covers clients that do not run VS Code tasks.
